description: The figure is a two-level donut/pie chart summarizing categories related to “multiple turns of entangled instructions,” with an inner ring showing three high-level groups and an outer ring showing nine specific task types with counts. The inner ring has 3 slices: “Context Tracking” (dark blue, roughly one-third), “Context Retrieving” (dark teal/green, roughly one-third), and “Contradiction Resolution” (reddish brown, roughly one-third), with the group names written inside the slices. The outer ring has 9 slices labeled with counts (no percentages shown): “Triggering” (light blue, 100), “Recursive Reasoning” (bright blue, 110), “Dynamic Environment” (blue, 100), “Memorization” (light cyan, 100), “Dynamic Instruction” (teal, 100), “Multitasking” (green, 160), “Privacy Protection” (red, 111), “Personalization” (salmon, 100), and one additional top-left slice whose label is blurred/unreadable (light pink, 100). Labels are placed outside with leader lines; there is no separate legend, and no slice appears exploded, though the outer slices are separated by white borders. The outer slices appear to be grouped around the ring by the corresponding inner-ring category rather than ordered strictly by size.
